intents.response: TOPKEK Productions is a one-person brand named TOPKEK. VJ, animator, dev, maker of satirical games and experiments; trained as a plumber. Short version: he builds stuff that amuses him.
topkek has no official contact channels but I can forward a message if you want

APPSTAIN is a satirical Trump clicker — build an empire, collect Acts, dodge impeachment. Still in alpha. Open it from the right-hand terminal menu: click the "> APPSTAIN" line. The modal asks for a password tied to the KEK riddle — I'm not spelling that out.
VAJBUJ is TOPKEK's music experiment. Type /vajbuj in the terminal to fire it up.
Type /help for a short command list or /help full for the full reference. Anything with `/` is a command. Everything else — ask away.
Main thing is APPSTAIN Trump-Epstain satire game. Then SCNDBREJN (memory browser), Glitch Lab, GENIMG. It's all in the terminal.
Glitch Lab is a glitch-art tool. Open it from the right-hand terminal menu: click the "> Glitch Lab" line.
SCNDBREJN is a memory/notes experiment. Open the modal from the right-hand terminal menu: click the "> SCNDBREJN" line. Deeper tooling may run locally as a separate app — the modal explains the gist.
I'm Bruuuh. Technical assistant focused on webdev. Dry humor, direct, no fluff. Ask.
Szczecin. Don't confuse it with Warsaw — different planet.
GENIMG v1.3 — on-site gallery and notes about the GENIMG workspace. Open it from the right-hand terminal menu: click the "> GENIMG" line.

Graphics profile comes from the URL: add `?perf=lite`, `?perf=full`, or `?perf=auto` (choice is remembered in localStorage). Lite trims heavy effects on weaker machines. When your profile allows it, use the bottom console: `/postproc status`, `/sao`, `/bloom`, `/crt`. There's a Performance HUD in the top-left stack next to the camera readout.

The big "TOPKEK" voxel scene is Three.js in the page. Mouse animation modes (Repulsion, Scatter, Grid, …) live in the right-hand control panel. Free / dynamic camera toggles are in the top-left camera HUD. Slash commands in the bottom console control postprocess, lights, and `/fx` — not the mouse mode buttons.

Letter FX run through the console: `/fx list` shows effect ids and aliases, `/fx trigger` fires once, `/fx start` loops, `/fx stop` stops instances, `/fx status` shows the runtime. Use `/help full` for every line including shortcut commands.

The 3D "Animation portfolio" sequence: in the right-hand terminal menu, click "> Animation portfolio". That starts the in-scene fly-in; click the same line again to exit and restore normal camera controls.
Embedded Vimeo test reel: in the terminal menu, click "> Portfolio (Vimeo test)" — opens the video modal.

Bottom bar: lines starting with `/` are terminal commands (`/help`, `/help full`, `/fx`, `/clear`, …). Anything without a leading slash is free text — I (Buuch) match it against this knowledge base. `/clear` wipes the console log.
Static site: vanilla HTML/CSS/JS as ES modules, Three.js r160 from CDN (import map), no bundler. Served as plain files — `python -m http.server` or any static host.
